rasterPolicy: Optional CPU mode omits paints only into the main output canvas and temporary-body output canvases after their real alpha bounds/readiness are measured. Transforms, metrics, decoding, source masks, scratch canvases, readbacks and all geometry/anchor updates remain active. Paired mode compares identical seeded command, result and combat-event streams.
renderPolicy: First scene rendered at 0.5 DPR for software-GL correctness; subsequent bone soak skips unobserved GPU submissions and render-target readbacks. No performance claim.
overlapPolicy: Reference 80% footprint radii, actual ankle-mesh footprint hulls with the same margin, and actual cover bounds with the reference half-radius margin.

weaponCoverage.policy: Campaign rotates all 24 Workshop weapons; actual all-weapon landed-contact coverage, built-ins and shoulder launcher are asserted separately by scene-combat.cjs.
